## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on selective names: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing pickup: LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**

Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.52%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND. Utilities/Real Estate pressured: VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.18% | 1M: -7.77%) BELOW TREND.

Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology concentration in broader top-performer list).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND, MO (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.52%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select large-cap names and healthcare/tech laggards.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W momentum: LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large caps with 1W ≠ 1M — e.g., META, AMZN, TSLA) — watch for trend break; treat moves as tactical, not core reallocation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but active: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -11.10%) RECOVERY — sector breadth positive in the 7/11 count but internal rotation and concentration persist.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed/soft: JPM (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND but sector 1W negative; V (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +1.61%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +4.42%) CORRECTION — breadth skewed to mixed, so Financials not uniform leaders.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Generally constructive but bifurcated: LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +10.64%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND — watch headlines-driven dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor names with confirmed ABOVE TREND and breadth confirmation (MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to large-cap laggards showing below-trend confirmation (CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broader sector strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.46% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (XOM (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND) and selective Technology names. BEARISH: Utilities and Real Estate (VST (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -10.07%) BELOW TREND; CCI (1W: -5.18% | 1M: -7.77%) BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: sustained weekly follow-through above recent 1W highs to confirm continuation of ABOVE TREND. AAPL: reclaim of 1M trend (positive monthly momentum) needed to exit BELOW TREND. CVS: failure to stabilize near current levels would confirm further BELOW TREND downside. JPM: sustained weekly strength to validate Financials rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MRK (+85): FDA/EMA win on RSV in children — cross-ref price not in top movers this week, watch for confirmation. TMO (+80): new FDA-cleared platform — sector-confirming given healthcare strength (TMO price not listed). MET (+80): $3bn repurchase — financials noise but sector 1W weak; watch for confirmation. (All listed with headline scores; monitor price follow-through.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-60): legal trial chatter vs children’s addiction — price RECOVERY (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -11.10%) — divergence (negative sentiment with a short-term bounce). UNH (-55): political scrutiny — price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -6.27%) confirming downside risk. HON (-50): guidance disappointment — price CORRECTION (1W: -7.50% | 1M: +3.54%) aligns with near-term weakness; monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broad 7/11 sector breadth. MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +6.86%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (META RECOVERY, AMZN CORRECTION, TSLA RECOVERY) and bearish news on META/CVS — treat moves tactically and monitor confirmation before shifting core allocations.
